summary: RogerPodacter 的协议内隐私池 EIP 合并为草案，定义私密 ETH 与 ERC-20 转账的标准系统合约。lightclient 提交 EIP-8141 内存池策略初稿，改用标准 paymaster 合约以去掉 ERC-7562 复杂的质押信誉系统。_julianma 解释快速确认规则，L2 与交易所存款时间可降至约 13 秒。

items.title: 新增 EIP：私密 ETH 与 ERC-20 转账
items.note: （RogerPodacter）合并：协议内隐私池系统合约，为 ETH 与 ERC-20 私密转账定义标准有效性层，公开存取；固定地址、仅能通过硬分叉升级、无管理员密钥，共享票据树与 nullifier 集合，采用递归证明架构。
items.title_en: Add EIP: Private ETH and ERC-20 Transfers
items.note_en: (RogerPodacter), merged: a protocol enshrined privacy pool system contract defining a canonical validity layer for private ETH and ERC-20 transfers with public deposits and withdrawals; fixed address, hard fork only upgrades, no admin keys, a shared note tree and nullifier set, and a recursive proof architecture.

items.topic: 原生 AA：EIP-8141 内存池策略
items.title: EIP-8141：新增内存池策略
items.note: （lightclient）提交：与 ERC-7562 相比的重要变化是依赖一个标准 paymaster 合约，从而去掉围绕质押的复杂信誉系统，日后可逐步扩展功能。
items.note_en: (lightclient), submitted: the key change versus ERC-7562 is relying on a canonical paymaster contract, which removes the complex staking based reputation system and can gain features over time.

items.title: _julianma：快速确认规则说明
items.note: 17:23，据 Ethereal news #16，规则假设网络同步且对手不控制超过 25% 质押，失败时回落到最终性，L2 与交易所存款时间降至约 13 秒，未来几个月推出；binji_x：快 60 倍的确认对用户意味着什么 18:37；benjaminion_xyz：这不是快速最终性，但对多数应用是巨大升级 18:59。
items.note_en: 17:23; per Ethereal news #16, the rule assumes a synchronous network and an adversary with at most 25% of stake, falls back to finality, cuts L2 and exchange deposits to about 13 seconds and rolls out in the coming months; binji_x: what 60x faster confirmation means for users, 18:37; benjaminion_xyz: it is not fast finality, but an incredible upgrade for most applications, 18:59.

summary_en: RogerPodacter's protocol enshrined privacy pool EIP merged as a draft, defining a canonical system contract for private ETH and ERC-20 transfers. lightclient submitted a first draft of EIP-8141 mempool policy built on a canonical paymaster contract, removing ERC-7562's complex staking reputation system. _julianma explained the fast confirmation rule, which cuts L2 and exchange deposit times to about 13 seconds.
